steps.en: Customer opens the furnish page and sees Singpass and Corppass login options
steps.id: Customer membuka halaman furnish dan melihat pilihan login Singpass dan Corppass

steps.en: Customer picks Singpass or Corppass and is sent to log in
steps.id: Customer memilih Singpass atau Corppass lalu diarahkan untuk login
steps.why_en: The redirect to login exists, but the Singpass or Corppass check itself runs outside this system and cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Pengalihan ke login ada, tetapi pengecekan Singpass atau Corppass sendiri berjalan di luar sistem ini dan tidak bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: After login succeeds, a secure session holding the user's ID is created
steps.id: Setelah login berhasil, session aman berisi ID pengguna dibuat

steps.en: Customer sees the outstanding notices that belong to their own ID
steps.id: Customer melihat notice outstanding yang terdaftar atas ID-nya sendiri

steps.en: Customer ticks one or more notices and moves on to fill in particulars
steps.id: Customer mencentang satu atau lebih notice lalu lanjut mengisi particulars
